fuente.titulo: Pope Leo greets young Ukrainian cancer survivor as he departs hospital

titular: Pope Leo greets Ukrainian girl leaving hospital
bajada: Varvara, 13, gave him a photo and a stuffed toy from her wartime journey
caption: As Pope Leo XIV left Rome's Gemelli Hospital, he was greeted by Varvara, a 13-year-old Ukrainian girl he had first met on December 31 while she awaited cancer surgery. She gave him a photograph of their earlier embrace in St. Peter's Square and a stuffed toy like the one she carried while fleeing the war. Source: Vatican News, Oct 17, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: Exterior of Gemelli Hospital entrance, soft daylight, a small stuffed toy resting on a stone bench; a papal figure in white departs in the upper right, seen from behind, left and center open and calm.
